opening.argument: The presentation identifies a GMX exchange on the Avalanche network while promoting annualized returns, including “GMX network Avax +15% per annum” and an approximately 18 percent annual figure. It also makes commissions conditional on purchasing a GLP token, stating that “in order to. get commissions you need to buy a glp token,” and describes that token as a crypto index containing stablecoins and other crypto assets. The visible GMX screen reinforces that these claims concern active crypto participation, showing staked assets and an approximately $1072.12 balance. The presentation also directs viewers to subscribe to a channel. These facts establish an investment, lending, or staking-returns opportunity, although the available evidence does not verify that the figures are guaranteed, accurate, net of costs, or realized by viewers.
